attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) backed by loopback-file physical volumes on node1 (no spare disk/partition existed), formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data, seeded test data, then grew the LV live from 1000M to <2.25 GiB (2,344,615,936 bytes) via a second loop-backed PV + vgextend + lvextend + online xfs_growfs while it stayed mounted throughout. Data integrity (sha256 checksums) was verified before and after growth. Persistence across reboot was wired via a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loop-images.service) that reattaches the loop devices before local-fs-pre.target, plus an /etc/fstab entry with x-systemd.requires. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id + healthy LVM/mount/checksum baseline, issued a deferred systemd reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified full recovery (PVs reattached, VG/LV active, filesystem mounted at correct 2.25GiB size, files present and checksums OK).
